channelTitle: You pour this down the drain - Grandma June rinses hair with it
hook: You have been pouring this down the drain every time you cook rice.
remedy: A traditional beauty habit passed down for generations: rinsing hair with the water left over from rinsing rice. Old-fashioned households swore it left hair softer and shinier.
steps: Save the cloudy water from the second rice rinse
Let it sit an hour, then use the clear top layer
Pour through clean hair, leave 5 minutes, rinse out
cta: Would you try a rice water rinse? Tell Grandma June in the comments
